text_blocks.snippet: The primary medication for polymyalgia rheumatica (PMR) is corticosteroids, specifically prednisone or prednisolone, which are typically taken orally. These medications help to reduce inflammation and relieve the pain and stiffness associated with PMR. In some cases, steroid-sparing agents like methotrexate or sarilumab may be used alongside or instead of corticosteroids, especially for patients who experience side effects from long-term steroid use or have difficulty tapering off corticosteroids.
